A2 · WALK IT WITH ME BEFORE IT EXISTS · 1902 E Ewing, South Bend
Nobody in this market posts the vision before the work.
The payoff reel exists the moment the rehab finishes.
Captions are machine-generated. Read them before you ship.

CHECK THE HEAD FOR A BUDGET FIGURE
The cut already starts at 0:02 to drop it. Scrub the first
few seconds and confirm no dollar amount is spoken or captioned.
Zero dollar figures is rule one.

KEEP “THREE-ONE TO THREE-TWO”
That is bed-bath config language and matches the site exactly.
CUT the “potentially four” aside. It is speculative and the
site should never carry a config that is not final.

PAINT-DAY STILL HOLDS 2 BEATS
Only still in the batch and genuinely mid-work: drop cloths,
buckets, front door open behind it. Needs end card and music.
